You will work for a progressive and highly automated concrete factory in Amsterdam. Since 1935, the company has provided innovative and sustainable solutions for the construction industry, with a team of around 60 permanent employees and a flexible workforce. The atmosphere is informal, friendly and focused on teamwork. As a welder, you will be part of a close-knit team where personal development is encouraged. 
As a Welder, you will work on high-quality prefab constructions at an innovative company in Amsterdam. You will have plenty of freedom, work in an informal team and receive a good monthly salary. Personal development and a pleasant working atmosphere are key. 
About the function 
As a welder, you start your day by reviewing construction drawings and preparing materials. You cut and bend metal to size, assemble reinforcement using CO2 welding and carry out tack welding. You work accurately, as the quality of the final product depends on your precision. Together with your fellow welders, you discuss the planning and meet deadlines by working together and supporting each other. During the day, you check your work and make sure every part meets high standards. You will work on prefab elements that contribute to major construction projects across the Netherlands. 
What we offer - Salary between €3,000 and €3,500 per month - Work with an enthusiastic and experienced team - Modern equipment and techniques - Plenty of room to develop yourself further 
What we need - Experience as a welder - You work accurately and safely - You are a team player with a sense of responsibility - You speak Dutch and/or English - You are available to work: 05:45 - 14:30 or 14:30 - 22:30
